durable.text: He is a low-usage role player who adds little in counting stats. His only plus is few turnovers, and that comes from low volume.

note: Both Yahoo and ESPN value him at 0 USD and rank him around 300 (303 and 301). That is far outside the 144 players drafted in our league, so do not draft him. The projections have him around 19 minutes with weak points, rebounds, steals and blocks, and the experts see a limited ceiling. Only look at him on waivers if injuries push him into Indiana's regular wing rotation.
